primary_learner.prediction_contract: calculate family loss separately for each frozen seed-specific model and average the five family losses equally

comparators.definition: constant median of source-domain ROP labels only
comparators.allowed_interpretation: whether feature-conditioned predictive information transports beyond a deployment-available source-only constant

comparators.definition: source-only frozen low-complexity linear predictor using the same feature contract
comparators.allowed_interpretation: whether nonlinear complexity provides incremental external transport value

comparison_wording.ExtraTrees_gt_SourceMedian: learned conditional transport exists relative to the source-only constant baseline
comparison_wording.ExtraTrees_gt_Ridge: nonlinear model complexity provides incremental external transport value
comparison_wording.ExtraTrees_gt_SourceMedian_but_not_Ridge: learned transport exists, but nonlinear complexity is not shown to be necessary
comparison_wording.ExtraTrees_not_gt_SourceMedian: little or negative evidence of useful external conditional transport under the frozen endpoint

prohibitions: No Layer D target labels in training or model selection
No replacement of the primary learner after outcome unlock
No post-outcome hyperparameter or normalization changes
No engineering baseline with an incompatible feature contract
